title: test(cli): compile each scaffold sandbox in process, one spawn per distinct lint-eval run, budget the generate/i18n spawn files
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XSSr8Pe8L9chsNc1qbg5uPE)_

Part of #23181 (slice 27, the generate / scaffold / i18n family in `packages/cli/test`). The card stays open for later slices.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`packages/cli/test` 里 6 个超过 10 s 的测试文件。`lint-eval-generator-refusal-separator` 去掉两次与前面完全相同的 CLI 子进程(6 次变 4 次)；`scaffold-emission-typechecks` 不再每个用例起一个 `tsc` 子进程，改为进程内每个脚手架一个独立的 TypeScript Program，共享已解析的 lib 与 spec 声明文件；另外 4 个文件每次子进程都是不同的工作，只加第 2 行 `// test-budget:` 头。
- **为什么改**：卡 #23181 的测试提速职责：超过 10 s 的文件要么提速，要么按裁决 6181973363 B 声明预算。
- **风险与回滚**：只改测试文件，不发布任何东西(cli 的 `files[]` 只有 dist、README、CHANGELOG)；没有删改任何断言、用例名、超时或分层；回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/cli/test/scaffold-emission-typechecks.test.ts` 的 `typecheckProject`(进程内编译与声明文件缓存)；`packages/cli/test/lint-eval-generator-refusal-separator.test.ts` 的 `beforeAll`；其余 4 个文件只有第 2 行。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/scaffold-emission-typechecks.test.ts` → 13/13 通过，canary 仍以 TS2694 变红。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Slice 23's offender table (the default reporter's per-file line in every Test Core shard log of the five scheduled `ci.yml` runs `41199450735`, `41217827347`, `41237094739`, `41255489006`, `41271604267`) names these six files over 10 s with no header.

**Cause, per file.** I counted child processes against distinct (command, flags, fixture) triples:

| file | CI max (s) | tests | children | distinct triples | cause | fix |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|:--|:--|
| `lint-eval-generator-refusal-separator` | 35.7 | 5 | 6 source-CLI spawns | 4 | the same-door case re-spawned the two `--json` runs the cases above it already ran | the 4 distinct runs move into one `beforeAll`; every case reads them. Header 50 |
| `scaffold-emission-typechecks` | 33.0 | 13 | 12 `tsc` children (canary, 3 `os init` templates, 8 `os g` generators) | 12 sandboxes | each child loads the compiler and parses and binds the same `lib.*.d.ts` and `@objectstack/spec` declarations again | in process, one Program per sandbox from its own `tsconfig.json`, with one shared cache of the parsed declaration files outside the sandboxes. Header 50 |
| `generate-stack-reach` | 31.0 | 8 | 10 spawns, already in one `beforeAll` | 10 | distinct real work (five fixtures, each refusal read against its own byte snapshot) | header 40 |
| `dependency-range-doors` | 27.6 | 5 | 5 spawns | 5 | distinct real work | header 40 |
| `i18n-extract-check-json` | 22.2 | 5 | 8 spawns (1 setup extract + 7) | 8 | distinct real work | header 30 |
| `i18n-extract-check-dry-run` | 19.3 | 5 | 7 spawns (1 setup extract + 6) | 7 | distinct real work | header 30 |

**`lint-eval-generator-refusal-separator`.** The same-door case compared `--json --generator ""` with `--json --generator MISSING_PATH`, two runs with the same command, flags and fixture as the first and third cases. It now reads those runs. The pair it compares and every assertion are unchanged. The `beforeAll` timeout is the old per-case allowance times four.

**`scaffold-emission-typechecks`.** Each sandbox still compiles as its own Program, from its own `tsconfig.json` (the one `renderScaffoldTsconfig` writes), so no scaffold can lean on another's declarations. The verdict is `tsc --noEmit`'s: `getPreEmitDiagnostics` (config, options, global, syntactic, semantic, declaration) plus the emit diagnostics, exit 0 exactly when none is an error, and the output is those diagnostics in `--pretty false` form. Only files outside the sandbox are cached, keyed by path and parse options. All sandboxes compile under the same `SCAFFOLD_TSCONFIG_COMPILER_OPTIONS`; they differ only in `rootDir` and `include`, which change no parse. This is the compiler's own reuse model: the language service shares source files across programs the same way. The compiler is the same `typescript` package `typescript/bin/tsc` resolved to. The docblock says all this in a new "One compiler, one Program per sandbox" section.

**Headers** (ruling 6181973363 letter B): N = the slowest of the five CI readings × 1.25, rounded up to 10 s. Classes: `spawns the real producer once per single-cause fixture` for the five spawn files, `compiles the package type graph once` for `scaffold-emission-typechecks`. The two fixed files keep their pre-fix CI reading. All six parse with `readTestBudget` (`scripts/measure-test-shard-timings.mjs`).

Not changed: no assertion, case name, per-case timeout, tier, project or test helper. No source file.

## Tests

- **A/B** (one box, one lock hold, N=3, `--maxWorkers=1`, base and head interleaved): the base file's bytes were written into the same path for each base leg and restored from `HEAD` after it, checked by blob hash, so both legs ran in the same tier and the same `DECLARATION_READER_FILES` slot (a `zzbase.*` copy beside it would not). Vitest's `Duration` line, with no per-file line in single-file runs:

  | file | base (s) | head (s) | change |
  |:--|:--|:--|--:|
  | `scaffold-emission-typechecks` | 26.81, 27.16, 25.54 | 15.31, 16.85, 16.52 | −38.8% (mean 26.50 → 16.23); the tests phase 18.2 → 7.3 s |
  | `lint-eval-generator-refusal-separator` | 32.29, 32.95, 33.75 | 22.76, 26.32, 25.12 | −25.1% (mean 33.00 → 24.73) |

  Every leg exit 0, 13/13 and 5/5 tests on both sides.
- **The in-process verdict matches `tsc` (one-time probe, not committed):** a copy of the head file ran both the in-process compile and the old `tsc` child on every sandbox. Same verdict on all 12, the same error codes (canary `TS2694` on both, none elsewhere). A second canary run after all the others, with the cache warm, still answers `TS2694`. `tsc --noEmit` exits 2 on an error under TypeScript 6.0.3, so the in-process verdict answers 2 too.
- **All six files on head**, in one run: 6/6 files, 41/41 tests.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (tsc + `check:test-typecheck`) exit 0.
- No ablation: test-only, no tested behaviour changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **A lever outside this order's fix list.** These five spawn files start `bin/run-dev.js` through `node_modules/.bin/tsx`. The migrate files moved to `process.execPath` in slice 12. One `os lint --eval --json --generator ""` spawn here, without the queue-tier manifest: 9.5 to 11.8 s through tsx, 5.3 to 5.4 s through node, with byte-identical stdout. Not taken: the order rules the fix set (shared `beforeAll`, in-process read, header). Carrier: #23181.
- **The two i18n files share work across files.** Both run the same setup extract and the same `--check` control over an empty `--out`. Sharing it would need a helper beyond these files or a file merge, so it was not done.
- **`skip-changeset`.** Test-only. `@objectstack/cli`'s `files[]` is `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and `test/` is not built into `dist/`, so no `files[]` content changes.

## Verification

All readings on head `cc5ee375` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`).

- **Derived gate families:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` gives 48 families. Each ran with its exit code captured before any pipe. Two first reads were container prerequisites and were re-read after meeting them: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exited 3 on the shallow clone, then 0 after `git fetch --depth=1` of its positive-control commit; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 with no full build, then 0 after `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2` (118/118 tasks). `--ran` reconciliation: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 48 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 48 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- **Hand gates:** `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the six files exit 0 (`@objectstack/cli` has no `lint` script; the repo-wide `pnpm lint` runs in CI). `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` exit 0.
- **CI** families (Test Core with both cli tiers, the lint farm, the type-check lanes) are read off this PR's check-runs by the seat.
- Evidence (gate list with exit codes, A/B logs summary, the tsc equivalence probe output): `pm-orders/server/evidence/23181-s27/` in the project files.
